acceptanceCriteria.ac: All instance responses (GET/PUT/POST) return flat parameters + categories mapping
Parameters grouped into Basic (Units, Sensors - expanded) and Advanced (collapsed) sections
Unit selection dropdown for temperature (K/C/F) and airflow (m³/s, cfm, L/s, m³/h)
Conditional visibility: sensor toggle changes hide/show related panel fields AND node input handles
Save button calls PUT /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances/{instance_id} and updates node handles
Uses existing side panel patterns from Designer (FunctionPropertiesContainer pattern)

constraints.constraint: Use shadcn/ui components for all UI elements (Sheet, Select, Input, Switch, Collapsible, Button)
Follow existing PropertiesPanel pattern for side panel structure
Use generated types from OpenAPI - do not manually redefine ReheatParameters
API client functions must wrap generated SDK functions with error handling
Maintain existing test health (435+ tests passing)
Keep form state local to panel - update Zustand store only on successful save
Use TDD approach - write tests alongside implementation
Do not add comments unless explaining WHY (per CLAUDE.md)

interface.name: GET /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances/{instance_id}
interface.signature: GET → { instance_id: string, parameters: ReheatParameters, categories: Record<string, string[]> }

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances/{instance_id}
interface.signature: PUT { parameters: ReheatParameters } → { instance_id: string, parameters: ReheatParameters, categories: Record<string, string[]> }

interface.name: POST /api/v1/g36/vav-reheat/instances
interface.signature: POST { parameters?: ReheatParameters } → { instance_id: string, parameters: ReheatParameters, categories: Record<string, string[]> }

interface.name: ReheatParameters
interface.signature: type ReheatParameters = { temperatureUnit?: TemperatureUnit; airflowUnit?: AirflowUnit; hasCO2Sensor?: boolean; ... 50+ fields }

tests.standards: Designer uses Jest with @testing-library/react for component tests. Tests are colocated with source files using .spec.ts/.spec.tsx extension. Mock API calls using jest.mock or MSW. Follow existing patterns in apps/designer/src/components/sidebar/*.spec.tsx and apps/designer/src/domains/control-sequence/api/client.spec.ts.
